target: Risk lane L3 (mutates a CI-enforced proof contract; independent audit required before merge). Add truthful first-class opencode-cli / kimi-k3 representation to the trusted embedded-audit contract so a genuine opencode CLI audit running the cheaper-inference Kimi K3 model can be recorded as PASS without fabricating an auditor identity and without abusing SKIPPED semantics. Admits exactly one pair, opencode-cli / kimi-k3, bound fail-closed in both directions. This packet fixes the vocabulary; it does not audit, accept, or merge any other packet.
invariants: Existing enum values and SKIPPED behaviour are unchanged: every tool/model pair valid under the pre-change schema stays valid, proven by a differential test against the pre-change schema read from git rather than a paraphrase of its rules.

The opencode/kimi pair is bound in both directions: auditor_model kimi-k3 requires auditor_tool opencode-cli, and auditor_tool opencode-cli requires auditor_model kimi-k3. Neither half may be borrowed by another runner.

kimi-k3 is the model id served by the cheaper-inference broker (https://api.cheaperinference.com/v1, opencode provider key 'cheaper-inference'), verified live reachable and selectable. It is the ONLY non-billing-blocked live auditor route in this environment as of authoring.

Only opencode-cli / kimi-k3 is admitted. Any other opencode model or Kimi selector (e.g. moonshotai/kimi-k3, kimi-k3.5, kimi-k2.6) is deliberately NOT admitted: the operator authorized kimi-k3 only, and admitting any further opencode/Kimi surface is a separate operator decision.

This packet's own controlling audit must NOT be performed by opencode-cli/kimi-k3. A route that bootstraps its own admission is not an independent audit. Use a pre-change-representable route (agy/antigravity/grok/claude/others), and if none is available due to external provider billing, stop and report BLOCKED_AUDITOR_BOOTSTRAP exactly as the grok precedent (TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-GROK-ROUTE-001 S5) documents.
No runtime behaviour changes. No proof bundle other than this packet's is edited.
PR #1307 is NOT touched by this packet; this packet only admits the vocabulary so a later, separate run can audit #1307 with the opencode/kimi route.

pr.title: feat(audit): admit the opencode-cli/kimi-k3 embedded-audit route
pr.body:
The trusted embedded-audit contract had no vocabulary for the opencode CLI runner: auditor_tool enumerated [agy, antigravity, claude-code-cli, copilot-cli, gemini-cli, grok-cli, pal-mcp-clink, none] and auditor_model enumerated [sonnet, claude-sonnet-4.6, opus, gemini, gemini-3.1-pro-high, grok-4.5, unknown], with zero opencode/kimi entries, additionalProperties false, and the allOf forbidding tool 'none' or model 'unknown' for any non-SKIPPED status. An opencode CLI audit over the cheaper-inference Kimi K3 route therefore had only two representable encodings, both false: claim SKIPPED (asserts no audit happened) or name a runner from the enum (fabricates an auditor identity).

This fixes the vocabulary instead of teaching the evidence to lie. It admits exactly one pair, opencode-cli / kimi-k3, bound fail-closed in both directions so neither half can be stated without the other, following the grok-cli/grok-4.5 precedent (TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-GROK-ROUTE-001) and matching its bidirectional fail-closed conditionals.

Backward compatibility is proven at class level, not by sample: a differential test reads the pre-change schema from git and asserts old and new agree on the verdict for every pre-change tool/model pair across all five statuses. The proof corpus revalidates under the new schema.

Scope mirrors the grok precedent. scripts/audit/run_embedded_audit.py is deliberately NOT changed (it holds no auditor recognition table). scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py is likewise unchanged, being tool-agnostic and delegating to Draft7. The one consumer that must change is the parity corpus in tests/audit/test_local_audit_acceptance.py, which pins the conditional count and demands a violating fixture per conditional.

No runtime behaviour changes and no other packet's proof bundle is edited. This packet does NOT audit PR #1307; it only admits the vocabulary so a later run can.

steps.task: Perform a deterministic consumer inventory of the embedded-audit auditor_tool/auditor_model enums on current main before mutating the contract, and record which sites change and which are excluded with reasons.
Add opencode-cli to auditor_tool and kimi-k3 to auditor_model, plus the two fail-closed conditionals binding the pair in both directions, each self-contained via then.required.
Extend the local-acceptance parity corpus with violating fixtures for both new conditionals and update the pinned conditional count.
Prove no regression across the existing proof corpus under the new schema.

Obtain an independent controlling audit from a route representable by the PRE-change schema. opencode-cli/kimi-k3 is forbidden as this packet's auditor (bootstrap rule). If no representable independent route is available due to external provider billing, stop and report BLOCKED_AUDITOR_BOOTSTRAP.
